dt-example.title: Simple initialisation
dt-example.info:
The StateRestore extension for DataTables provides a library and UI to let an end user create a list of table states, which they can then apply to the table with a simple click, or set a default state for when the table is loaded. Such functionality is useful when working with complex data and you have a set of search terms that you frequently apply - StateRestore makes it possible to jump between states with just a couple of clicks.
In this simple example, you will see that `-init stateRestore` is used to initialise StateRestore with its default configuration, and the `-button stateCreate` and `-button statesList` buttons are used to let an end user create a new state from the state a table is in, and also provide a button to list the saved states.
